recovery.title: Disaster Recovery
recovery.desc: Ensuring zero data loss and near-instant recovery through automated replication, failover orchestration, and rigorous continuity planning.

overview_desc_1: In a world of unpredictable outages and cyber-attacks, a disaster recovery (DR) plan is not optional—it's survival. We architect systems that mirror your critical data across geographic regions in real-time. If one region goes dark, your business stays light.
overview_desc_2: Our disaster recovery services focus on two primary metrics: Recovery Point Objective (RPO) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO). We implement the technical guardrails to ensure that your data is never more than a few seconds old and your services are restored in minutes.

overview_cards.title: Continuous Replication
overview_cards.desc: Byte-level data mirroring between regions to ensure zero data loss during regional failure.

overview_cards.title: Failover Orchestration
overview_cards.desc: Automated DNS and traffic rerouting to healthy infrastructure without human intervention.

overview_cards.title: Immutable Backups
overview_cards.desc: Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) storage to protect against ransomware and accidental deletion.

envs.title: Syncing
envs.desc: Low-latency background replication of file systems and database transactions.

envs.title: Testing
envs.desc: Regular, automated testing of failover scripts to verify recovery readiness.

envs.title: Restore
envs.desc: Controlled or automated promotion of secondary region to primary status.

reliability.title: Guaranteed Resilience
reliability.desc: We build with the 'Chaos Engineering' mindset: intentionally testing for failure to prove that our recovery systems actually work under pressure.

metrics.label: Restore Velocity
metrics.desc: Average time to full DNS cutover.

layers.title: Air-Gapped Storage
layers.desc: Logically isolated backups that are unreachable from the production network.

layers.title: Encrypted Replication
layers.desc: End-to-end TLS 1.3 for all data moving between regional zones.

layers.title: Strict DR Access
layers.desc: Break-glass protocols with multi-user authorization for failover actions.

layers.title: Integrity Checking
layers.desc: Cryptographic checksum verification of every mirrored block.

cards.title: Edge Rerouting
cards.desc: Leveraging Anycast IP to shift traffic at the network edge in milliseconds.

cards.title: Warm-Up Logic
cards.desc: Pre-warming standby resources to ensure immediate production-level performance.

cards.title: Delta Syncing
cards.desc: Only replicating changed bits to minimize bandwidth and impact on latency.

operations.title: DR Control Center
operations.desc: Operating a global safety net through transparent reporting and 1-click execution.

logs.l1: Primary region health check: FAILED (Region: us-east-1).
logs.l4: Redirecting global DNS to Standby region (eu-central-1).

cards.title: Point-in-Time
cards.desc: Rewind your entire environment to any second before a corruption event.

cards.title: Multi-Cloud Exit
cards.desc: Ensuring your data can be moved to a different provider if needed.

cards.title: Business Logic DR
cards.desc: Recovering not just data, but the exact state of your business workflows.

cost.title: Stability Economics
cost.desc: We balance protection levels against cost, ensuring you aren't paying for overkill where it isn't needed.

migration.title: Continuity Onboarding
migration.desc: Integrating disaster recovery into your existing architecture without rewriting the core.
